message.content: {"rules":["`self` must be valid for both reads and writes.","`self` must be properly aligned, even if `T` has size 0.","`self` must be nonnull, even if `T` has size 0.","The value pointed to by `self` must be valid for dropping, including any additional invariants required by its type.","While `drop_in_place` is executing, parts of the value pointed to by `self` may be accessed only through the `&mut self` references supplied to the `Drop::drop` methods it invokes.","If `T` is not `Copy`, using the pointed-to value after calling `drop_in_place` can cause undefined behavior; assigning through `*self` counts as a use because it drops the value again.","`write()` may be used to overwrite the data after dropping without causing it to be dropped again.","This method may be used to drop pinned data when `T` is not `repr(packed)`; pinned data must not be moved before it is dropped.","Unaligned values must be copied to an aligned location using `ptr::read_unaligned` before being dropped; for packed structs, the compiler performs this move automatically, so their fields are not dropped in place."]}
